items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: George Brown played drums... we wound up with... In 1950, I got this group together... The drummer I grew up with... George Brown played drums.

ctx.x: No, it wasn't Cecil Payne. Anyway, Jo Jones had been working with Illinois, and Jo left for some reason, and I think Shadow Wilson was supposed to have come back with the band. As a matter of fact, I think Shadow did come back and worked a week or so with him. Then we went to Providence, Rhode Island, and it seems as if, at the time we left New York, Shadow couldn't be found anywhere, and we had to leave without him. In the meantime, Illinois is frantic to have a drummer, and he asked me about a drummer. So I…

So we sent and got Dude Brown, and Dude Brown came into Providence. And the rest is history, because I think since then, Illinois has probably used Dude Brown more than any other drummer, here and in Europe and a lot of other places.
